description: A week of step counts where clicking a bar selects it, dims the others and updates the header.
overview: Uses `BarChart` with one `Bar` (`dataKey="steps"`, `radius={5}`, `maxBarSize={28}`, `isAnimationActive={false}`) containing a `Cell` per day. Each `Cell` uses `var(--color-steps)` (`chartConfig.steps` is `var(--orange)`) at full opacity when selected and `fillOpacity` 0.3 otherwise. `chartData` holds seven `{ day, steps, index }` records. The selected index lives in `React.useState` (initially Saturday) and is set by the `Bar` `onClick`. There is no tooltip; the header shows the selected day's steps.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your own records and keep the `.map` that adds `index`, which the `Cell` opacity check relies on. Change the initial value passed to `React.useState` to preselect a different bar, and adjust the inactive `fillOpacity` for more or less contrast.
notes: A `KeyboardPoint` child reads `useActiveTooltipDataPoints` to track the bar focused with the arrow keys, and `onKeyDown` on `ChartContainer` selects it with Return or Space. The header value is in an `aria-live="polite"` region so changes are announced.
